t3.text: Big Picture Mode — Steam Deck & TV

s1.text:
Try in Play:
• Play Saltmarsh: pulls the newer save from the Steam Deck first
• Play Hollow Signal: save conflict, pick which copy wins
• Install Northbound: download → extract → setup → play
• Stop a game: the save uploads as a new version

Window chrome per OS: Tweaks › Platform
Big Picture (top right) opens Big Picture Mode

s2.text:
Controller-first, touch works too.
Click into the screen, then:
Arrows = D-pad · Enter = A · Esc = B
M = ☰ Menu · V = ⧉ Quick access
Q / E = L1 / R1 in Library

Footer buttons are clickable. Menu › Exit Big Picture returns to the desktop prototype.
